# Location scope: active Roman Theme or Yuan Branch Secretariat jurisdiction.
oe_ux2_is_imperial_admin_location_trigger = {
	has_owner = yes
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_yp_unit
		oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes
	}
}

# Location scope: Steam Railway Depot or Steam Ironworks hub.
oe_ux2_is_rail_hub_location_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_stm_early_steam_railway_depot
		has_building_with_at_least_one_level = oe_stm_steam_ironworks
	}
}

# Location scope: Grand Canal or monumental hydraulic node (native + OEBYZ).
oe_ux2_is_canal_node_location_trigger = {
	OR = {
		is_canal_open = yes
		has_canal_construction = yes
		has_building = building_type:oe_egypt_canal
		has_building = building_type:oe_wnd_hangzhou_canal_hub
	}
}

# Location scope: high-density imperial road corridor node.
oe_ux2_is_corridor_hub_location_trigger = {
	OR = {
		num_roads >= 3
		has_road_to_capital = yes
	}
}

# Location scope: active epidemic or provincial starvation crisis.
oe_ux2_is_epidemic_famine_location_trigger = {
	OR = {
		has_any_disease_present = yes
		AND = {
			has_owner = yes
			province = { is_starving = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: extended Little Ice Age winter, severe winter, or low food reserve.
oe_ux2_is_winter_stress_location_trigger = {
	OR = {
		area = { has_extended_winter = yes }
		winter_level = severe
		AND = {
			has_owner = yes
			province = { province_food_percentage < 0.25 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: overlord holding at least one subject or tributary.
oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = {
	is_overlord = yes
	num_subjects >= 1
}

# Country scope: Roman / Byzantine suzerain sphere (overlord or subject).
oe_ux2_in_roman_sphere_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes
			OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM }
		}
		AND = {
			is_subject = yes
			top_overlord ?= { OR = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ has_or_had_tag = ROM } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: Celestial / Sinosphere suzerain bloc (overlord or subject).
oe_ux2_in_celestial_sphere_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes
			OR = { has_or_had_tag = CHI has_or_had_tag = YUA has_or_had_tag = MNG has_or_had_tag = MCH }
		}
		AND = {
			is_subject = yes
			top_overlord ?= { OR = { has_or_had_tag = CHI has_or_had_tag = YUA has_or_had_tag = MNG has_or_had_tag = MCH } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: Atlantic & Central European suzerain bloc (overlord or subject).
oe_ux2_in_western_sphere_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = FRA has_or_had_tag = SPA has_or_had_tag = CAS
				has_or_had_tag = ENG has_or_had_tag = GBR has_or_had_tag = HAB
				has_or_had_tag = BOH has_or_had_tag = POR has_or_had_tag = NED
			}
		}
		AND = {
			is_subject = yes
			top_overlord ?= {
				OR = {
					has_or_had_tag = FRA has_or_had_tag = SPA has_or_had_tag = CAS
					has_or_had_tag = ENG has_or_had_tag = GBR has_or_had_tag = HAB
					has_or_had_tag = BOH has_or_had_tag = POR has_or_had_tag = NED
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: Eurasian Steppe & Islamic suzerain bloc (overlord or subject).
oe_ux2_in_steppe_islamic_sphere_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			oe_ux2_is_great_suzerain_trigger = yes
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = TUR has_or_had_tag = MAM has_or_had_tag = EGY
				has_or_had_tag = TIM has_or_had_tag = IRA has_or_had_tag = GLH
				has_or_had_tag = CHG has_or_had_tag = DLH has_or_had_tag = MUG
			}
		}
		AND = {
			is_subject = yes
			top_overlord ?= {
				OR = {
					has_or_had_tag = TUR has_or_had_tag = MAM has_or_had_tag = EGY
					has_or_had_tag = TIM has_or_had_tag = IRA has_or_had_tag = GLH
					has_or_had_tag = CHG has_or_had_tag = DLH has_or_had_tag = MUG

}

# Country scope: member of any of the 6 Great Civilization IOs (all unique = yes).
oe_ux2_in_great_civ_io_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:hre
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:tatar_yoke
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:tatar_yoke
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:japanese_shogunate
		}
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: eligible human player for cartography & ledger showcase events.
oe_ux2_showcase_eligible_trigger = {
	is_ai = no
	oe_main_mod_1337_showcase_allowed = yes
	num_locations > 0
}
